steps.name: Vigil Gate
steps.wikiText: Vigil Gate is a point of interest within Jora's Keep in Bjora Marches. This massive gate marks the entrance to Jora's Keep. There is a large statue of Raven on top of the gate, showing whether or not the Keep is currently blessed by Raven.

steps.name: Jora's Keep Waypoint
steps.wikiText: Jora's Keep is the local Vigil stronghold in Bjora Marches. It stands where the homestead of Jora herself once was.

steps.name: General's Quarters
steps.wikiText: General's Quarters is a point of interest within Jora's Keep, where the current leader of the Vigil's presence in Bjora Marches works and sleeps.

steps.name: Southern Mountains
steps.wikiText: On the mountainside to the South of Jora's Keep

steps.name: Aberrant Den
steps.wikiText: Aberrant Den is a point of interest within the Ravenfrost Caverns in Bjora Marches. It contains many Aberrant enemies, and is home to the Champion Aberrant Murellow.

steps.name: Ruined Hut
steps.wikiText: The Ruined Hut is a dilapidated hut within the Aberrant Forest in Bjora Marches. A starving kodan, Bright Shore, can be found huddled inside.

steps.name: Fallen Ruins
steps.wikiText: From Raven's Gate POI, follow the road South into the Aberrant Forest region. The vista is located to the right above the Fallen Ruins.

steps.name: Boneskinner Den
steps.wikiText: Boneskinner Den is a point of interest within the Aberrant Forest in Bjora Marches. This is likely where the Champion Boneskinner makes its home, but usually the area is full of smaller Aberrant enemies.

steps.name: Raven's Gate
steps.wikiText: Raven's Gate is a point of interest in Bjora Marches which straddles the border between Frozen Pass and the Raven Sanctum, marking the entrance to the latter. The gate opens for characters that have completed The Invitation story step.

steps.name: Gates of Svanir
steps.wikiText: Gates of Svanir is a point of interest within Asgeir's Legacy in Bjora Marches. These huge shards of ice entirely prevent access to Asgeir's Legacy unless the Storms of Winter has been cleared.

steps.name: Frozen Pass
steps.wikiText: The Frozen Pass is the central area within Bjora Marches.

steps.name: Northwest Svanir Camp
steps.wikiText: Northwest Svanir Camp is a point of interest within the Svanir Plateau in Bjora Marches.

steps.name: Darkrime Ruins
steps.wikiText: Darkrime Ruins is a point of interest within the Darkrime Delves in Bjora Marches. This cave-in marks what would have been the entrance to the snow jotun caves of old.

steps.name: Mystery of the Labyrinth
steps.wikiText: Mystery of the Labyrinth is a point of interest and light puzzle hidden in Fallen Mountains, accessible through a Raven Gate under a rock shelter north of the Northeast Svanir Camp.

steps.name: Northeast Svanir Camp
steps.wikiText: Northeast Svanir Camp is a point of interest within the Svanir Plateau in Bjora Marches. This Sons of Svanir camp is one of four in the eastern half of the Bjora Marches, and one of two which holds prisoners of the forces from Jora's Keep.

steps.name: Bear Shrine
steps.wikiText: The Bear Shrine is an ancient, now abandoned, shrine to Bear, within Bjora Marches. The Fallen patrol the ruins and attack any trespasser they come across.

steps.name: Fallen Mountains
steps.wikiText: To the North of Jora's Keep and south of the Bear Shrine POI-- high up on the mountaintop

steps.name: Southeast Svanir Camp
steps.wikiText: Southeast Svanir Camp is one of the four camps in the Svanir Plateau in Bjora Marches.

steps.name: Claw's Perch
steps.wikiText: Claw's Perch is a watchtower and point of interest within Bjora Marches. The structure has been overrun with Sons of Svanir, and at the top is a Raven Light Shrine which may be used to begin the Lighting the Frozen Pass puzzle.

steps.name: Southwest Svanir Camp
steps.wikiText: Southwest Svanir Camp is a point of interest within the Svanir Plateau in Bjora Marches. This Sons of Svanir camp is one of four in the eastern half of the Bjora Marches, and one of two which holds prisoners of the forces from Jora's Keep.

steps.name: Raven Pass
steps.wikiText: Raven Pass is a point of interest within the Raven Sanctum in Bjora Marches. It leads to the entrance of the Sanctum Arena instance where the three raid encounters take place.

steps.name: Mystery of the Hidden Tower
steps.wikiText: Mystery of the Hidden Tower marks the beginning of the light puzzle in Eaglewatch Rise.

steps.name: Shrine of the Vigilant Eagle
steps.wikiText: The Shrine of the Vigilant Eagle is a point of interest within Eaglewatch Rise in Bjora Marches. The shrine is regularly corrupted, requiring purification rituals.

steps.name: Eaglewatch Rise
steps.wikiText: Atop the ridgeline separating the Rime Glen and Eaglewatch Rise regions above the Whisperwind Grotto POI

steps.name: Whisperwind Grotto
steps.wikiText: The Whisperwind Grotto is a point of interest within Rime Glen in Bjora Marches. A Strange Kodan can sometimes be seen near the waterfall, manipulated by the whispers in the area.

steps.name: Cavern of Lost Sons
steps.wikiText: The Cavern of Lost Sons is a point of interest within Frigid Dunes in Bjora Marches. The entrance is on the west side of the Frigid Dunes.

steps.name: Den of Whispers
steps.wikiText: The Den of Whispers is a point of interest within Whispering Depths in Bjora Marches, where Jhavi Jorasdottir faces off against Drakkar in the second phase of their battle.

steps.name: Kodan's Leap
steps.wikiText: Kodan's Leap is a point of interest within Frigid Dunes in Bjora Marches. A Strange Kodan can sometimes be seen at the top of the cliff, jumping off to his death.

steps.name: Koda's Tears
steps.wikiText: Koda's Tears is a waterfall within Boreal Pass in the western part of Bjora Marches, near the Kodan Shipwreck.

steps.name: Kodan Shipwreck
steps.wikiText: The Kodan Shipwreck is the remains of the kodan ship that was used to flee south when Jormag rose.

steps.name: Still Waters Speaking Waypoint
steps.wikiText: Spirits' Refuge is an area in Bjora Marches, hosting a small kodan village.

steps.name: Still Waters Speaking
steps.wikiText: Still Waters Speaking is a kodan settlement off the shores of Drakkar Lake in Bjora Marches. The settlement is named after Drakkar Lake itself, and the whispers that come from the icy waters.

steps.name: Spirits' Refuge
steps.wikiText: On the cliffside just to the Northeast of the waypoint.

steps.name: Shrine of the Resilient Ox
steps.wikiText: The Shrine of the Resilient Ox is a point of interest within Frostborn Cascades in Bjora Marches. The shrine is regularly corrupted, requiring purification rituals. When corrupted, several salt block offerings appear nearby.

steps.name: Frostborn Cascades
steps.wikiText: On the cliffside to the northeast of the Shrine of the Resilient Ox POI.

steps.name: Ice Spire Peaks
steps.wikiText: On the promontory overlooking the Forest of a Thousand Voices region, northeast of the Shrine of the Valorous Wolverine POI

steps.name: Mystery of the Raven Gate Ruins
steps.wikiText: Mystery of the Raven Gate Ruins marks the beginning of the light puzzle in Raven Ruins.

steps.name: Shrine of the Valorous Wolverine
steps.wikiText: Shrine of the Valorous Wolverine is a point of interest within the Ice Spire Peaks in Bjora Marches. The shrine is regularly corrupted, requiring purification rituals.

steps.name: Sifhalla Ruins
steps.wikiText: Sifhalla Ruins are norn and dwarven structures found beneath the ice of the flooded and refrozen Drakkar Lake. They were once the homestead of the famous norn, Sif Shadowhunter. There is a Wolf shrine nearby.
